question.text: Event-driven strategies in Cat III AIFs typically take positions around:

answer.text: Material corporate events such as debt restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs or management change, including activist/special situations involving bankruptcy or NCLT proceedings

explanation.text: The Logic: Event-driven strategies take positions around material corporate events — debt restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs and management change — and activist/special-situations strategies may involve bankruptcy or NCLT proceedings, with distressed asset/debt funds investing more generally in distressed paper. The Trap: Government-bond-only, short-only or IPO-only descriptions do not match the workbook's event-driven and activist framing. Note: Verify the manager's experience with the specific corporate-event situations targeted, including any NCLT/special-situation track record.
